title: California Dreamin' Balloon Adventures

services.name: Who flies the balloon?
services.desc: Sunrise over an enchanted vineyard? Yes, and it’s you ascending on a cushion of wind, breaking the bonds of gravity aboard a beautiful California Dreamin’ Hot Air Balloon in Temecula Valley Wine Country. A sunrise hot air balloon ride over Temecula wine country begins in near silence. You lift off as the valley is still waking, the vineyards below going gold in the first light. From up here you take in the whole of Temecula Valley wine country: the olive groves and citrus orchards, the Santa Rosa mountains along the horizon, and on the clearest mornings a thin line of ocean in the far distance.
